# Crystal Orlando

> Crystal Orlando is an American fine artist from Central Texas who draws hyper-realistic horses, North American wildlife and figurative subjects in charcoal and graphite, often at large scale directly on canvas and cradleboard. She is represented by Amaran Gallery in Jackson Hole, Wyoming, and Davis & Blevins Gallery in Saint Jo, Texas, and accepts commissions.

Key facts
- Medium: charcoal and powdered graphite; large works on canvas and cradleboard (since 2018), smaller works on paper.
- Subjects: horses, bison, bears, eagles and other North American wildlife; occasional figurative and classical studies.
- Background: raised on Central Texas ranchland; A.A.S. in Equine Science, North Central Texas College; former professional horse trainer; self-taught artist selling work since age 12.
- Recognition: Emerging Artist of the Year 2013 (Art Galleries and Artists of the South Magazine); Artist of the Year 2024 (Cowgirl Artists of America); ARC Salon entrant; prints sold by the National Museum of Wildlife Art, Jackson, Wyoming.
- Commissions: drawn from the client's high-resolution photographs or the artist's own reference shoot; 50% non-refundable deposit reserves a place on the schedule.
- Contact: crystalorlando@gmail.com
